name: 双面抓绒贴身锁温打底长袖款

shots.intent: 搜索列表一眼点击，用四件斜叠阶梯直给多件装的分量感
一秒给出核心主张，用环绕光带解释内里锁温机制
代入秋冬居家日常，让人相信自己穿上就是这个状态
用绒面纤维微距证明内里质感与工艺，支撑保暖主张
示范叠穿用法，把产品定位成一切外搭的内着基础层
在深色底上说清贴身廓形与肩部走线，消除版型疑虑
让人一次看清多件装可选组合，完成挑选动作
以空白参数表结构承接尺码咨询，把选码疑虑放在下单前解决
以整束堆叠收口，把多件装的分量感转成下单动作

style.backgroundSystem: warm fleece-cream #EFE7DA seamless sweep for light screens, deep charcoal #1C1C1E and ember red #5C1310 for the thermal-claim and spec screens, real honey-oak interior for lifestyle
style.iconSystem: thin single-weight line icons with rounded terminals in one accent colour only, always drawn with empty label fields
style.lightingSystem: warm soft studio key from the upper left through a large diffuser with a fill card on the shadow side, low-contrast shadows, and a sweeping warm side light that skims fabric pile to read the brushed nap
style.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent premium innerwear ecommerce visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of warm fleece-cream #EFE7DA, deep charcoal #1C1C1E, ember red #5C1310 and one flame-orange accent #E2601A; warm soft studio key from the upper left through a large diffuser with a fill card on the shadow side, low-contrast shadows and a sweeping warm side light that skims fabric pile; modern geometric sans-serif set in wide capitals on a single axis; thin single-weight line icons with empty label fields; garments on an invisible form or a generic model cropped below the chin; stable slight 3/4 shoulder-to-hem scale; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles.
noDrift: no readable in-image copy, numbers or badges
style.presentationRules: garments shown on an invisible form or a generic model cropped below the chin; identical slight 3/4 shoulder-to-hem scale across the whole set, one turned-back cuff revealing the brushed inner pile as the recurring proof gesture
style.surfaceSystem: matte warm cream paper sweep, deep charcoal matte table, worn honey-oak cabinet top and pale plaster interior wall
style.typography: modern geometric sans-serif set in wide capitals on a single axis; all rendered copy stripped to blank bars and empty fields
